tasks.title: Create CharacterCreatableSingleSelect in features/characters/components
tasks.specRef: Що потрібно зробити; Статус; Гендер; UX (all bullets)
doneWhen: new file apps/web/src/features/characters/components/character-creatable-single-select.tsx exports CharacterCreatableSingleSelect. It is not re-exported from features/characters/index.ts and imports nothing from features/books or from character-role-picker.tsx

the component is generic over a string option union. It takes the full option list plus the sentinel option, and removes the sentinel itself, so no caller passes a pre-filtered copy. It also takes a label function, the accessible label, maxLength, invalid, describedBy and the D1 clear target

onChange can only report a standard pick with empty text, or the sentinel with non-empty trimmed text. A standard option with non-empty text cannot be expressed (a discriminated union or an equivalent shape)

the component is built on cmdk CommandPrimitive with shouldFilter={false}, plus Popover / PopoverAnchor / PopoverContent and CommandPrimitive.Input. PopoverContent prevents onOpenAutoFocus and ignores outside interactions inside the anchor, as in character-role-picker.tsx:178-189

the accessible name comes from the CommandPrimitive `label` prop, because cmdk overrides the input's id and aria-labelledby (audit C25). aria-describedby and aria-invalid are passed to CommandPrimitive.Input
displayed text: for a standard value, its translated label. For the sentinel with non-empty custom text, that text and never the sentinel label. For the sentinel with empty text, the D4 outcome
opening the list without typing shows every standard option except the sentinel, and does not filter by the currently displayed label
typing filters standard options by normalizeName(label).includes(normalizeName(typed)), using normalizeName from @app/shared

a create item (plus icon + the T1 create label with the trimmed text) renders only when the trimmed text is non-empty and the D3 rule finds no standard match. It never renders for whitespace-only input

Enter commits the highlighted item, which by default is the first standard match ranked above the create item. ArrowDown opens a closed list. ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the highlight. A mouse click on any item commits it and closes the list
Escape closes the list. Escape, blur and outside click follow D2 for typed-but-uncommitted text
the component adds no Enter handler that calls stopPropagation or re-dispatches submit, so the cmdk root preventDefault keeps the enclosing form from submitting
Home and End in the input call event.stopPropagation() so cmdk does not hijack caret movement (precedent character-role-picker.tsx:104)

the clear button is a type='button' native button with cursor-pointer and an aria-label from T1/common.clear. It reports the D1 clear target with empty custom text, and is not rendered when the value already equals the clear target and no text is typed

the input box is h-10 with field tokens (border-input, bg-field, focus ring), so it lines up with the sibling SelectTrigger 'w-full data-[size=default]:h-10' in a sm:grid-cols-2 row. It uses no raw colours
the file has no comments, no `any` and no non-null `!`. Any `as` is limited to what cmdk/Radix types force

openDecisions.question: What does «clear» set Status and Gender to? Neither field has a null value.
options: A. Status clears to 'not_specified' («Не вказано»), gender to 'unknown' («Невідомо»), both with empty custom text. The clear button is hidden while the value already equals that target
B. Clear only empties the typed search text and never changes the stored value
C. Clear on Status only. Gender gets no clear button, since it has no 'nothing chosen' value
openDecisions.codebaseCost: A is what both fields default to for a new character (add-character-schema.ts:29, :39; shared characters.ts:187, :232; character-edit-form.ts:142), and 'not_specified' is already the first status option (character-options.ts:51). Narrator and attitude in the same form clear back to their empty value (character-edit-sections.tsx:376-379, :765). B makes 'clear' a no-op for the stored value, and C makes the two pickers behave differently.
openDecisions.recommendation: A. It gives one meaning of clear across the form: back to the value a new character starts with.

openDecisions.question: Editing model: what the input shows while a value is selected, how typing starts, and what happens to typed text that was never committed (blur, outside click, Escape).
openDecisions.specSays: A creatable single-select with Enter/mouse selection and Escape. Silent on focus, typing and uncommitted text.
options: A. The input shows the committed label. Focus selects all of it, so the first keystroke replaces it, and the list shows every option until the user edits. Typed text is only a search. Only Enter or a click commits. Blur, outside click and Escape restore the committed label
B. Same as A, but blur commits non-empty typed text as a custom value (free-text behaviour, as in StoreAutocomplete / DeliveryServiceAutocomplete)
C. The input empties when the list opens and shows the committed label as its placeholder. Uncommitted text is reverted as in A
openDecisions.codebaseCost: No single-select creatable exists in the repo (audit C10). Store and Delivery are free-text, with input = value (store-autocomplete.tsx:85-88), so B is what they do. SeriesAutocomplete keeps the label in the input and deselects to null on typing (series-autocomplete.tsx:166-170), which is impossible here. A and C cost the same: one local search state plus a revert on close.
openDecisions.recommendation: A. Under B, a partial search like 'мер' left by tabbing away silently becomes a custom status. A also matches the spec's Escape bullet, which only makes sense as cancel. It keeps the stored value visible, where C hides it behind a placeholder.
openDecisions.specRef: UX bullets: Enter / Escape / mouse selection

openDecisions.question: When does typed text count as 'the same as a standard option', which hides the create item and lets Enter pick the standard one?
openDecisions.specSays: 'не показувати create action, якщо введений текст збігається зі стандартним option'
options: A. normalizeName equality (collapse whitespace + lowercase) against the translated label in the current locale, as the role picker does. Typing a sentinel label ('Інше', 'Свій варіант') is not special-cased: it creates a custom value with that text
C. A, plus no create item when the text equals the current custom value
openDecisions.codebaseCost: A is already in the feature (character-role-picker.tsx:42-57, normalizeName at packages/shared/src/common.ts:116), and the role picker test locks the case and space rule (character-role-picker.test.tsx:407-414). B would offer «Створити «живий»» next to «Живий». C adds a branch for an idempotent re-create.
openDecisions.recommendation: A. It matches the role picker the spec points at, and the case and space rule already has a test.

openDecisions.question: What does the picker show for a sentinel stored without text (status='other' with statusCustomText null; gender='custom' with customGender null)?
openDecisions.specSays: Only the case with text: show the text, not «Інше» / «Свій варіант».
options: A. Fall back to the sentinel label («Інше» / «Свій варіант»), the same rule as the details page
B. Show an empty input with the placeholder
openDecisions.codebaseCost: For status this is real data. The old UI marked «Свій статус» optional (character-edit-sections.tsx:236), and nothing requires the text (shared characters.ts:233). For gender the backend refuses it (characters.ts:196-204), so it is near-unreachable. A copies character-details-page.tsx:196 and :642. Under B a saved status looks as if no status were stored, while the value stays 'other'.
openDecisions.recommendation: A. It keeps edit and details consistent and never hides a stored value.

openDecisions.question: Which i18n keys does the picker use for the create label, the placeholder and clear?
openDecisions.specSays: 'використовувати існуючі i18n keys або додати мінімально необхідні'; label '+ Створити «{value}»'
options: A. Reuse characters.rolePicker.create («Створити «{name}»», uk.json:8137) and common.clear, and add no placeholder key
B. Add characters.creatableSelect.create («Створити «{name}»» / 'Create “{name}”') and characters.creatableSelect.placeholder, and reuse common.clear («Очистити», uk.json:11)
openDecisions.codebaseCost: A adds zero keys, but ties the Status and Gender wording to the role picker's namespace. Under A, a later edit to the role copy changes these fields too. B adds two keys in two files. In both options the four orphaned keys characters.edit.statusCustom, statusCustomPlaceholder, customGender and customGenderPlaceholder are deleted in T4/T6. 'Очистити' already labels two other clear buttons on this page (:376, :765).
openDecisions.recommendation: B. Two keys is minimal, and it avoids cross-component coupling of copy. The '+' is the plus icon, as in the role picker, not part of the string.

openDecisions.question: Should the live preview show the custom status text instead of «Інше»?
openDecisions.specSays: Nothing. The spec scopes the work to the two form fields and lists 'unrelated код' under 'не змінювати'.
options: A. Exclude it and leave it as a follow-up. The preview keeps showing «Інше» for every custom status

B. Include it as task T9: character-edit-preview.tsx shows statusCustomText when status is 'other' and the text is non-empty, otherwise tStatus(status), plus one assertion in character-edit-page.test.tsx
openDecisions.codebaseCost: The preview renders tStatus(status) (character-edit-preview.tsx:37, :43), while the details page already prefers the text (character-details-page.tsx:192-197). B is about 4 lines plus 1 test. A leaves the preview contradicting the picker beside it right after «У полоні» is created.
openDecisions.recommendation: B, flagged as a scope expansion the spec did not ask for. It applies the spec's own 'show the text, not «Інше»' rule to the one other place on the same page that renders this field. If the user wants the diff confined to the two fields, take A.

assumptions.source: Stage 5 accessibility audit (axe aria-valid-attr-value, critical) + code review
assumptions.statement: CharacterCreatableSingleSelect no longer uses cmdk. cmdk 1.1.1 Command.Input writes aria-expanded="true" after spreading props, and Input/List/Item overwrite any caller id, so inside a Popover the closed combobox pointed aria-controls/aria-activedescendant at ids absent from the DOM and could not expose the item highlighted on open. The component keeps the spec pattern of Popover + editable input + standard options + create option, but renders a native input role=combobox and its own role=listbox with useId ids.

T2: the component is built on cmdk CommandPrimitive with shouldFilter={false} ... CommandPrimitive.Input
the accessible name comes from the CommandPrimitive label prop
the component adds no Enter handler ... cmdk root preventDefault
Home and End in the input call event.stopPropagation()

replacementDoneWhen: the combobox input has role=combobox, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-label from the label prop, aria-expanded equal to the open state, aria-controls pointing at the listbox id only while open, and aria-activedescendant pointing at the highlighted option id only while open
opening without typed text highlights the current standard option, and nothing for a committed custom value, so Enter right after opening never changes the value
Enter calls preventDefault in the input keydown handler, so the enclosing form never submits
PopoverContent prevents onOpenAutoFocus and ignores outside interactions inside the anchor
axe reports no combobox or aria-valid-attr-value violation for Статус or Гендер with the list closed or open
